protocol: Post-final-test exploratory research. Original ES/NQ 2010–2023 training, internal 2022–2023 screening and full event verification, then actual MES/MNQ 2024–2025 reused selection-period validation. 2026 is sealed; this script never loads it. Independent confirmation requires new forward data.
rationale: Original research hypotheses, not established published edges: prior regular session is exactly 09:30–15:59 ET with all 390 bars and one contract. Roll mismatches disable entries. Completed 15/30-minute opening data only. Gap fade/continuation require 0.1–0.6 prior-range gap; trend pullback requires 0.05–0.5 and a 20-prior-session trend; small-gap momentum requires <0.1. Inside-day and failed-gap rules use prior completed regular-session extremes. Overnight/prior-day sweeps require a unique reversal direction. Fixed protective stops, at most one attempt per day. The 2026 consumed test is excluded; 2024–2025 is reused exploratory selection.
risk: One micro; $1800 risk stop and $2000 measured drawdown checks; same adverse fills and published cash commissions. Reference mini budgets scale 10x explicitly.
screening: Fast independent-trade screen is approximate, followed by mandatory continuous shared-engine reference verification. No prices filled; entries/exit gaps can disqualify a strategy. Earlier 2010–2021 economics must also be positive.

uncertainty.method: Circular session block bootstrap; weak stationarity assumed; not future probability
